items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: the best record today for trombone, the way I think trombone should be played and sounded, is this Murray McAckred.

ctx.x: Yeah, he stood in the next room the day I went to take a lesson. He was playing a, I forget the name of the tune, but it sounded like a human voice. The most beautiful thing I ever heard on the trombone of my life. And to me, the best record today for trombone, the way I think trombone should be played and sounded, is this Murray McAckred. Oh, yeah. He made a record of Sleepy Time Girl with the Casaloma Band. After that you can take the record. But he plays that so beautiful and phrases so wonderful. And for…
What's your favorite record that you made yourself, if you had to pick one or two?
